mapper.select: SELECT config_key,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.package_name')) package_name,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.version')) version,DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.released_at'))) released_at FROM t_system_config WHERE is_active=1 AND config_key LIKE 'APP_VERSION:%' AND JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.released_at') IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.released_at'))),INTERVAL 3 DAY)<=CURDATE()
